docs.summary: A clip baked into muscle space, one [`HumanPose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanPose) per frame, so it plays on any humanoid. [`Bind`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanoidClip~Bind) turns it into an ordinary clip for one avatar.
The avatar scale the clip was baked from, used to rescale root motion onto a different rig.
The float channels baked alongside the muscles, matched by name when the clip is bound.

Binds the clip to one humanoid avatar, giving an ordinary clip on that avatar's skeleton. Root motion is rescaled by the two avatars' scales so a bigger rig covers proportionally more ground.
